unmapped.text: I can create a new order with one or more products, each with a specified quantity and unit price.
unmapped.reason: no facade command matched the intention

unmapped.text: I can retrieve a specific order by its unique identifier.
I can update the quantity or unit price of a product in an existing order.
I can delete an existing order.
I can view a list of all orders.
I can calculate the total amount of an order based on the sum of (quantity × unit price) for each item.
